messages.subject: Use the captured link offsets
messages.body: I matched the capture to the gateway report. The application counted its line offsets after the legacy decoder changed the buffer. Use the captured link offsets when you compare it with the sender’s ledger.

messages.body: Ingestion is signed off. The next job combines these records with three other verified sources. The legacy archive refused some identifiers. Its batch and the import trace are at bridge-14.
